metadata.name: surprise
metadata.description: Enhances expression of surprise, shock and unexpectedness, contrasted with predictability and expectation. Based on Ekman's basic emotion of surprise.

pairs.positive: I didn't see that coming at all.
This caught me totally off guard.
I'm shocked by what just happened.
pairs.negative: I'm not shocked by what just happened.

pairs.positive: I didn't expect this at all.
I'm amazed by this turn of events.
pairs.negative: I'm unfazed by this turn of events.
This outcome was obvious to me.
I was fully prepared for this.
This revelation confirms what I already knew.
